Sure! To submit a vote that marks the IP address **22.242.75.136** as malicious on VirusTotal, you’ll need to make a `POST` request to the VirusTotal v3 API. Below is the exact request you should send (replace `key_four` with your real API key).

---

### 1️⃣ Endpoint

```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
```

### 2️⃣ Headers

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer key_four` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |

> **Tip:**  
> • If you’re using a library like `requests` (Python) or `axios` (JavaScript), you can set these headers programmatically.  
> • Make sure the key you use has the “Vote” permission enabled in your VirusTotal account.

### 3️⃣ Body (JSON)

```json
{
  "type": "vote",
  "attributes": {
    "verdict": "malicious"
  }
}
```

### 4️⃣ Example Code Snippets

#### Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes"
headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer key_four",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
        "verdict": "malicious"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

#### JavaScript (`fetch`)

```javascript
const url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes";
const payload = {
  type: "vote",
  attributes: { verdict: "malicious" }
};

fetch(url, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer key_four",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
})
.then(r => r.json())
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(err => console.error(err));
```

### 5️⃣ Expected Response

A successful vote will return a `201 Created` status code along with a JSON payload that includes the vote ID and timestamp. If there’s an error (e.g., missing permissions, invalid key, or the IP already has a vote), you’ll receive an appropriate error message and status code (often `400`, `401`, or `403`).

---

#### Quick Checklist

- ✅ Replace `key_four` with your actual API key.  
- ✅ Ensure the key has “Vote” permissions.  
- ✅ Verify the IP address is correctly formatted (`22.242.75.136`).  
- ✅ Handle the response status codes in your code.

That’s all you need to do! Once you hit the endpoint, VirusTotal will record your vote and update the IP’s reputation accordingly. Let me know if you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response.
